pub struct RequestIdentity
  key: ::std::string::String
  history_epoch: ::std::string::String
  attempt: i64
pub struct Submission
  identity: RequestIdentity
  kind: ::std::string::String
  spec: ::std::vec::Vec<u8>
  required_guarantees: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
  label: ::std::string::String
pub struct Receipt
  identity: RequestIdentity
  logical_owner: ::std::string::String
  operation_id: ::std::string::String
  accepted_guarantees: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
  history_retention_ms: i64
pub struct AcceptanceResult
  outcome: AcceptanceOutcome
  receipt: ::std::option::Option<Receipt>
  reason: ::std::string::String
pub struct HistoryWindow
  logical_owner: ::std::string::String
  history_epoch: ::std::string::String
  minimum_retention_ms: i64
  result_retention_ms: i64
pub struct CancellationResult
  outcome: CancellationOutcome
pub struct WorkProgress
  done: i64
  total: i64
pub struct WorkFailure
  classification: FailureClass
  message: ::std::string::String
  cause: ::std::string::String
pub struct OperationSnapshot
  receipt: Receipt
  state: WorkState
  progress: WorkProgress
  cancellation_requested: bool
  failure: ::std::option::Option<WorkFailure>
  label: ::std::string::String
  label_derived: bool
  waiting: ::std::string::String
pub struct ObservationResult
  outcome: ObservationOutcome
  snapshot: ::std::option::Option<OperationSnapshot>
pub struct ResultChunk
  receipt: Receipt
  offset: i64
  total: i64
  data: ::std::vec::Vec<u8>
  eof: bool
pub struct ResultRead
  outcome: ResultOutcome
  chunk: ::std::option::Option<ResultChunk>
pub struct ResultLink
  outcome: LinkOutcome
  receipt: ::std::option::Option<Receipt>
  size: i64
pub struct WorkObservation
  outcome: WorkObservationOutcome
  next: ::std::string::String
  snapshot: ::std::option::Option<OperationSnapshot>
  mechanism: WorkObservationMechanism
pub struct InventoryPage
  outcome: InventoryOutcome
  snapshots: ::std::vec::Vec<OperationSnapshot>
  next: ::std::string::String
  complete: bool
pub struct OperatorCancellation
  outcome: OperatorCancellationOutcome
pub fn encode(v: &AcceptanceResult) -> ::std::vec::Vec<u8>

  offset: usize

pub struct ServiceError

pub enum CallError<E>
  Transport(E)
  Refusal(Refusal)
  Dispatch(&'static str)
  Service(ServiceError)
pub trait RecoverableAcceptance
  type Error
  fn get_history_window(&self) -> ::std::result::Result<HistoryWindow, Self::Error>
  fn submit(&self, submission: Submission) -> ::std::result::Result<AcceptanceResult, Self::Error>
  fn reconcile(&self, identity: RequestIdentity) -> ::std::result::Result<AcceptanceResult, Self::Error>
  fn cancel_work(&self, identity: RequestIdentity) -> ::std::result::Result<CancellationResult, Self::Error>
pub struct RecoverableAcceptanceClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait OperationControl
  type Error
  fn observe_work(&self, identity: RequestIdentity) -> ::std::result::Result<ObservationResult, Self::Error>
  fn follow_work(&self, identity: RequestIdentity, after: ::std::string::String, wait_ms: i64) -> ::std::result::Result<WorkObservation, Self::Error>
  fn read_result(&self, identity: RequestIdentity, offset: i64, max_bytes: i64) -> ::std::result::Result<ResultRead, Self::Error>
  fn link_result(&self, identity: RequestIdentity, destination: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<ResultLink, Self::Error>
pub struct OperationControlClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
  pub fn follow_work_pages(&self, identity: RequestIdentity, after: ::std::string::String, wait_ms: i64) -> impl ::std::iter::Iterator<Item=::std::result::Result<WorkObservation,CallError<T::Error>>> + '_
